title: MineDrill
description: MineDrill is a 3×3 automatic mining drill that supports multiple fuels, places torches every few blocks, and builds Cobblestone beneath itself for safe tunneling. Simple, efficient, and survival-friendly.
body:
![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8ade80070e379cbebd91bae6c66cb1598703071.webp)

⛏️ MineDrill – Advanced 3×3 Automatic Mining Drill

✨✨✨

**A fully rewritten 3×3 automatic mining drill with a fixed fuel system, no duplication bugs, smart torch placement, and automatic cobblestone path protection.**

✨✨✨

🔥 Critical Fixes

⛽ Fuel System Reworked – no more infinite fuel or duplication

🕯️ Torch System Fixed – consumes 1 torch every 8 blocks correctly

📦 Item Duplication Fixed – no more coal or torch duplication

🛡️ Bedrock Detection – drill stops instantly before bedrock

🚫 Unbreakable Blocks Protected – cannot break protected blocks

✨✨✨

🆕 New Features

🧱 Auto Cobblestone – places blocks under the drill over lava, water, or gaps

🎯 Improved Hitbox – matches the visual model perfectly

📝 Tooltip System – hold Shift for detailed info

🌍 Arabic Support – full ar_sa translation

⛏️ Tool Requirement – requires stone pickaxe or better to break

✨✨✨

🎮 Features

- ⛏️ 3×3 Mining – mines a full area at once

- ⛽ Flexible Fuel – supports multiple fuel types

- 🕯️ Auto Torch – places torch every 8 blocks

- 🧱 Path Safety – keeps the drill safe on dangerous terrain

- 🛡️ Bedrock Stop – prevents breaking into bedrock

- 🎒 2 Slots – fuel + torches

✨✨✨

🔥 Fuel Values

- 🪨 Block of Coal → 80 blocks
- 🌿 Dried Kelp Block → 20 blocks
- 🔥 Blaze Rod → 12 blocks
- ⚫ Coal → 8 blocks
- 🪵 Charcoal → 8 blocks

✨✨✨

🛡️ Protected Blocks

- Bedrock
- End Portal Frame
- End Portal
- Command Blocks
- Barrier
- Structure Block
- Spawner
- Reinforced Deepslate

✨✨✨

📖 How to Use

- ⛽ Insert fuel in Slot 1
- 🕯️ Insert torches in Slot 2
- ▶️ Press the start button
- ⛏️ The drill will mine automatically

✨✨✨

📋 Changelog v1.1.0

- ✔️ Reworked fuel system
- ✔️ Fixed torch duplication
- ✔️ Fixed item duplication
- ✔️ Added bedrock protection
- ✔️ Added unbreakable block protection
- ✔️ Added auto cobblestone placement
- ✔️ Improved hitbox
- ✔️ Added tooltip system
- ✔️ Added Arabic translation
- ✔️ Rewritten from MCreator to pure Java
- ✔️ Fixed GUI slots
- ✔️ Fixed crafting recipe
- ✔️ Requires stone pickaxe or better to break

✨✨✨

📜 License & Modpacks

✅ Free to use in modpacks

✨✨✨
